sources.title: inclusionAI/Ling-3.1-flash · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Introduction We're introducing Ling-3.1-flash, an upgraded native hybrid reasoning model designed for complex, real-world tasks. With 560B total parameters, 25B active parameters per token, and a 1M-token context window, Ling-3.1-flash builds upon Ling-3.0-flash with improvements in architecture, performance on real-world capabilities.
